title: Knuth-Plass
subtitle: Optimal line breaks as a tree of min-plus matrices: one paragraph loses, many can win.

chapters.title: Cheapest Breaks
chapters.blurb: A line costs its empty space squared, and a running minimum over earlier break points finds the cheapest breaks for the whole paragraph.

chapters.title: Chain Or Tree
chapters.blurb: Each step of the running minimum is a min-plus matrix, so the steps can be merged in a tree: far fewer layers, about ten times the work.

chapters.title: Many At Once
chapters.blurb: One paragraph loses to the round trip; a thousand paragraphs win with the dense-rows kernel and uploaded positions, but only within a shifting range.
